name: @vox/runtime-rn
description: JS-only stand-in for the uniffi-backed @vox/runtime-rn native module. Lets CI (and a local Expo Go run) bundle the generated app WITHOUT a native build. Methods log + return benign defaults. The real native module ships via EAS Build / a dev client.
comment: expo-file-system is imported by index.js (durable NDJSON journal). Declared here so Metro resolves it from the shim's own scope when the shim is installed as a `file:` dependency; the `*` dedupes to the SDK-compatible version the app's `expo install` pins.
